task.title: Why retries need jitter
task.why: A short deck shows the thundering-herd problem and the fix faster than prose.

ask: Should retries also cover 429 responses, or only 503?
context: CI already retries the whole job once
the server sends Retry-After on 429 but not on 503
done: Read the upload client and its call sites
Pulled the last 30 CI runs and counted failures
Reproduced the 503 flake locally with a stub server
